Positive interactions (at α=0.05) were observed for: family history and present life satisfaction; WHR and present life satisfaction; and WHR and sleep satisfaction (Table 7). It is important to note that the interaction obtained through the logistic regression analysis represents a multiplicative model. For example, the interaction between family history and present life satisfaction indicates that for females with a family history of breast cancer, those with poorer life satisfaction have an increased breast cancer risk.
